AmountOfEmissionToAir: The quantity of each pollutant released to air in the reporting period, reported where the law or an environmental management system already requires the undertaking to report it.
AmountOfEmissionToSoil: The quantity of each pollutant released to soil, for example through spills or storage, reported where the law or an environmental management system already requires the undertaking to report it.
AmountOfEmissionToWater: The quantity of each pollutant released to water, for example with waste water, reported where the law or an environmental management system already requires the undertaking to report it.
AmountOfWaterWithdrawnAtSitesLocatedInAr: Water drawn in at sites in areas of high water stress, where demand for water is high compared with what is available; water-risk maps such as WRI Aqueduct show these areas.
AreaOfSiteInBiodiversitySensitiveArea: The part of the site’s area that lies inside a biodiversity-sensitive area, such as a protected natural area.
Assets: The balance sheet total — the undertaking’s total assets — as shown in its financial statements for the reporting period.
AverageNumberOfAnnualTrainingHoursPerFem: Calculation: total training hours of female employees in the reporting period / number of female employees
AverageNumberOfAnnualTrainingHoursPerMal: Calculation: total training hours of male employees in the reporting period / number of male employees
AverageNumberOfAnnualTrainingHoursPerNon: Calculation: total training hours of employees who did not state their gender in the reporting period / number of such employees
AverageNumberOfAnnualTrainingHoursPerOth: Calculation: total training hours of employees of another gender in the reporting period / number of employees of another gender
BasisForPreparation: Option A means the report covers the Basic Module only; Option B adds the Comprehensive Module, which asks for further disclosures on top of the basic ones.
BasisForReporting: On an individual basis the report covers this undertaking alone; on a consolidated basis it covers the parent and the subsidiaries in its consolidated financial statements, which are then listed with their registered addresses.
CityOfSite: The city, town or village in which the site is located.
CountryOfPrimaryOperationsAndLocationOfS: The country where the undertaking mainly operates and where its significant assets, such as premises or equipment, are located.
CountryOfSite: The country in which the site is located.
DateOfAdoptionOfTransitionPlanForUnderta: If the undertaking has not adopted a transition plan yet, the date by which it intends to adopt one.
DescriptionOfATargetRelatedToAPolicy: Describe each target: what is measured, the level aimed for, the year by which it should be reached and the starting point it is measured from.
DescriptionOfATransitionPlanForClimateCh: For undertakings in high climate impact sectors — agriculture, mining, manufacturing, energy, water and waste, construction, trade, transport and real estate: describe the plan and how it reduces emissions.
DescriptionOfActionsTakeToAddressTheConf: Describe what the undertaking did about the confirmed incidents, for example putting right the harm to those affected and the steps taken to prevent a repeat.
DescriptionOfClimateRelatedHazardsAndCli: Describe the climate hazards that could affect the undertaking, for example floods, droughts or heatwaves, and the transition events, such as new carbon rules or shifts in customer demand.
DescriptionOfHowCircularEconomyPrinciple: Describe what the undertaking does, for example using recycled inputs, offering repair or take-back, or designing products to last longer and be easier to recycle.
DescriptionOfKeyElementsOfStrategyThatRe: Describe the parts of the undertaking’s strategy that depend on or affect sustainability matters, for example moving to more efficient equipment or developing lower-impact products.
DescriptionOfLimitsToTheDistributionOfPr: For a cooperative: describe any rules that limit paying out profits, for example a requirement to reinvest most of them in the cooperative’s activity or in services of general interest.
DescriptionOfPracticesPoliciesAndOrFutur: Describe briefly what each practice, policy or initiative covers and how it is put into practice, for example who applies it and how often it is reviewed.
DescriptionOfSignificantGroupsOfProducts: The main groups of products or services the undertaking sells, for example bakery products, freight transport or accounting services.
DescriptionOfTheEffectiveParticipationOf: For a cooperative: describe how workers, users, members or local communities take part in decisions, for example through voting rights at the general meeting.
DisclosureOfAnyOtherEnvironmentalAndOrEn: Any further environmental information that matters for the undertaking and is not asked for elsewhere, for example noise, odour or light pollution from its activity.
DisclosureOfAnyOtherGeneralAndOrEntitySp: Anything else about the undertaking or the reporting period that a reader needs and no other field asks for, for example a merger or a major change of activity during the year.
DisclosureOfAnyOtherGovernanceAndOrEntit: Any further information on how the undertaking is run that matters and is not asked for elsewhere, for example a whistleblowing channel or anti-corruption training.
DisclosureOfAnyOtherSocialAndOrEntitySpe: Any further social information that matters for the undertaking and is not asked for elsewhere, for example employee well-being schemes or community projects.
DisclosureOfHowItHasAssessedTheExposureA: Explain how the undertaking judged which of its assets, activities and parts of its value chain are exposed to these hazards and events, and how badly they could be affected.
DisclosureOfListOfMainActionsTheEntitySe: List the main actions planned to reach the targets, for example insulating buildings, replacing vehicles or switching to renewable electricity.
DisclosureOfWhetherItHasUndertakenClimat: Choose “Yes” if the undertaking has already taken steps to adapt to these hazards or events, for example flood protection, cooling for staff or alternative suppliers.
EmployeeCountingMethodology: Whether the number of employees is the figure at the end of the reporting period or the average over it. Use the same method wherever the report counts employees.
EmployeesReceivePayEqualOrAboveMinimumWa: Choose “Yes” if every employee is paid at least the minimum wage set by national law or by the applicable collective agreement.
EnergyConsumptionFromFuels: Energy from the fuels the undertaking burned, such as natural gas, diesel, petrol or wood, converted to megawatt-hours from the quantities on invoices or meter readings.
EnergyConsumptionFromSelfGeneratedElectr: Electricity the undertaking generated itself and consumed, for example from rooftop solar panels or its own wind turbine; electricity sold to the grid is not counted.
GPSLocationOfSite: Latitude and longitude in decimal degrees, separated by a comma, for example 47.0105,28.8638; separate several locations with a space.
GreenhouseGasEmissionReductionTargetBase: The year whose emissions the reduction target is measured against, for example 2023 if the target is a cut compared with 2023.
GreenhouseGasEmissionReductionTargetYear: The year by which the undertaking aims to reach its emission reduction target, for example 2030.
GrossLocationBasedScope2GreenhouseGasEmi: Emissions from producing the electricity, heat or steam the undertaking bought, calculated with the average emission factor of the grid where it is consumed.
GrossMarketBasedScope2GreenhouseGasEmiss: Emissions from the electricity, heat or steam the undertaking bought, calculated with the emission factors of its own supply contracts, for example a supplier-specific factor or certified renewable electricity.
GrossScope1GreenhouseGasEmissions: Emissions from sources the undertaking owns or controls, in tonnes of CO₂ equivalent, for example from burning fuel in its boilers and vehicles or from refrigerant leaks.
GrossScope3GreenhouseGasEmissions: The other indirect emissions in the undertaking’s value chain, for example from purchased goods and services, business travel, employee commuting or waste disposal.
LinkToPreviousReportContainingDisclosure: The web address of the previous report in which the unchanged disclosures can be read, for example a page on the undertaking’s website.
ListOfDisclosuresForWhichNoChangesAreRep: Select each disclosure for which nothing has changed since the previous reporting period.
ListOfOmittedDisclosuresDeemedToBeClassi: Select each disclosure the undertaking leaves out because it considers the information classified or sensitive. This list goes into the report: whoever reads it sees which disclosures were omitted — not why, which the standard does not ask for.
MostSeniorLevelAccountableForImplementat: The most senior position in the undertaking that answers for putting the policies into practice, for example the owner, the managing director or the board.
NaceSectorClassificationCodes: The code or codes of the sectors in which the undertaking carries out its main economic activities; if it has several significant activities, choose a code for each.
NameOfMaterialUsed: For manufacturing, construction or packaging: name each relevant material the undertaking uses, for example steel, timber, flour or plastic packaging.
NameOfTheSubsidiary: Only needed when reporting on a consolidated basis: the official name of each subsidiary the report covers.
NumberOfEmployees: People with an employment contract with the undertaking, as a headcount or in full-time equivalents; self-employed contractors and agency workers are not included.
NumberOfEmployeesForCountryOfEmploymentC: The number of employees by the country whose law governs their employment contract — needed when the undertaking employs people in more than one country.
NumberOfFatalitiesAsAResultOfWorkRelated: Deaths of employees in the reporting period caused by a work accident or by an illness resulting from their work.
NumberOfFemaleEmployees: Employees who state their gender as female, counted in the same way as the total number of employees.
NumberOfMaleEmployees: Employees who state their gender as male, counted in the same way as the total number of employees.
NumberOfNonReportedGenderEmployees: Employees who have chosen not to state their gender.
NumberOfOtherGenderEmployees: Employees who state a gender other than male or female.
NumberOfPermanentContractEmployees: Employees whose employment contract has no end date, counted in the same way as the total number of employees.
NumberOfRecordableWorkRelatedAccidentsIn: Work accidents to employees in the reporting period that led to death, time off work, restricted duties, medical treatment beyond first aid or loss of consciousness.
NumberOfTemporaryContractEmployees: Employees whose employment contract ends on a set date or when a set piece of work is finished, for example seasonal staff.
OtherUndertakingsLegalForm: Only needed when none of the listed legal forms fits the undertaking: name its legal form as it appears in its registration documents.
PostalCodeOfSite: The postal code of the site — any premises the undertaking owns, leases or manages, such as an office, shop, warehouse or production facility.
PotentialAdverseEffectsOfClimateRisksTha: Describe how climate risks could harm the undertaking’s finances or operations, for example damage to premises or higher energy costs, and rate each risk as high, medium or low.
PracticePolicyAndOrFutureInitiativeIsPub: Choose “Yes” if the practice, policy or initiative is published where anyone can read it, for example on the undertaking’s website.
PubliclyAvailableDisclosure: Choose “Yes” if the undertaking’s emissions to air, water and soil are already published, for example in an official register; the report can then point to them instead of repeating them.
RegisteredAddressOfTheSubsidiary: The address at which the subsidiary is officially registered, as in its registration documents.
ReportContainsDisclosuresFromThePrevious: Choose “Yes” if some disclosures in this report are carried over from the previous reporting period because they have not changed.
RevenueDerivedFromChemicalProduction: Revenue earned in the reporting period from producing chemicals — reported only if the undertaking is active in this sector.
RevenueDerivedFromCoal: Revenue earned in the reporting period from coal, for example from its extraction, processing, distribution or trade — reported only if the undertaking is active in this sector.
RevenueDerivedFromControversialWeaponsAn: Revenue earned in the reporting period from making or selling the weapons listed — reported only if the undertaking is involved in such activities.
RevenueDerivedFromCultivationAndProducti: Revenue earned in the reporting period from growing tobacco or producing tobacco products — reported only if the undertaking is active in this sector.
RevenueDerivedFromGas: Revenue earned in the reporting period from natural gas, for example from its extraction, processing, storage, distribution or trade — reported only if the undertaking is active in this sector.
RevenueDerivedFromOil: Revenue earned in the reporting period from oil, for example from its extraction, refining, storage, distribution or trade, including selling motor fuels — reported only if the undertaking is active in this sector.
SiteLocatedInABiodiversitySensitiveArea: Choose “Yes” if the site lies within a biodiversity-sensitive area, for example a protected natural area, a key biodiversity area or a UNESCO World Heritage site.
SiteLocatedNearABiodiversitySensitiveAre: Choose “Yes” if the site lies outside a biodiversity-sensitive area but close enough for its activity to affect it.
SpecificationOfAnyConfirmedIncidentInvol: Describe each confirmed incident involving workers in the value chain, affected communities, consumers or end-users: what happened and whom it affected.
SpecificationOfOtherHumanRightsRelatedTo: If an incident concerned a right that is not in the list, name it, for example freedom of association or the right to privacy.
SpecificationOfOtherTypesOfContentCovere: If the code or policy covers topics that are not in the list, name them, for example freedom of association, working hours or harassment.
SustainabilityIssueAddressedByPracticePo: Select every sustainability matter for which the undertaking has a practice, policy or planned initiative aimed at reducing its negative impacts or increasing its positive ones.
TimeHorizonsOfAnyClimateRelatedHazardsAn: State over what period each hazard or event could arise, for example short term within a year, medium term within five years, long term beyond that.
TotalAmountOfFinesForTheViolationOfAntic: The total of the fines imposed on the undertaking in the reporting period for breaches of anti-corruption or anti-bribery laws, in the report’s currency.
TotalAmountOfWaterWithdrawnFromAllSites: All the water the undertaking drew in at its sites during the reporting period — from the public supply, wells and boreholes or surface water — usually as shown on bills or meters.
TotalEnergyConsumption: All the energy the undertaking consumed in the reporting period, in megawatt-hours: electricity bought or generated on site plus fuels, split into renewable and non-renewable where known.
TotalGrossLocationBasedScope1AndScope2GH: Calculation: Scope 1 + Scope 2 GHG emissions (location-based), in tonnes of CO₂ equivalent
TotalGrossMarketBasedScope1AndScope2GHGE: Calculation: Scope 1 + Scope 2 GHG emissions (market-based), in tonnes of CO₂ equivalent
TotalHazardousWasteGeneratedMass: The total weight of hazardous waste the undertaking generated in the reporting period — waste with dangerous properties, such as used oils, solvents, batteries or chemicals.
TotalHazardousWasteGeneratedVolume: The total volume of hazardous waste generated in the reporting period, for example for liquid waste measured by volume.
TotalMassOfMaterialUsed: The weight of all relevant materials used in the reporting period, added together.
TotalNatureOrientedAreaOffSite: Land away from its sites that the undertaking owns or manages mainly for nature, for example a meadow or wetland it restores or protects.
TotalNatureOrientedAreaOnSite: Areas on the undertaking’s sites set aside mainly for nature, for example gardens with native plants, green roofs or green walls.
TotalNonHazardousWasteGeneratedMass: The total weight of all other waste the undertaking generated in the reporting period, such as paper, cardboard, plastics, scrap metal or food waste.
TotalNonHazardousWasteGeneratedVolume: The total volume of non-hazardous waste generated in the reporting period, for example for waste collected in containers of a known size.
TotalNumberOfConvictionsForTheViolationO: The number of convictions handed down in the reporting period for breaches of anti-corruption or anti-bribery laws by the undertaking.
TotalNumberOfSelfEmployedWorkersWithoutP: People who work only for the undertaking as self-employed contractors and have no staff of their own.
TotalNumberOfTemporaryWorkersProvidedByU: People working at the undertaking who are employed and supplied by a temporary-work agency rather than by the undertaking itself.
TotalRevenuesDerivedFromFossilFuelCoalOi: Calculation: revenue from coal + revenue from oil + revenue from natural gas
TotalSealedArea: Land whose soil is covered so that water can no longer soak in, such as buildings, roads, car parks and paved yards.
TotalUseOfLand: The total area of land the undertaking uses at all its sites, whether owned, leased or managed, built on or not.
TotalVolumeOfMaterialUsed: The volume of all relevant materials used in the reporting period, added together.
TotalWaterConsumption: Calculation: water withdrawn − water discharged from production processes. Reported where the undertaking has production processes that consume significant amounts of water.
Turnover: Net turnover from the financial statements for the reporting period: revenue from selling products and services, after discounts, VAT and other taxes linked to sales.
TypeOfContentCoveredByTheCodeOfConductOr: Select every topic the code or policy addresses, for example child labour, forced labour, discrimination or accident prevention.
TypeOfHumanRightRelatedToTheConfirmedInc: Select every type of breach the confirmed incidents involved, for example child labour, human trafficking or discrimination.
TypeOfNumberOfEmployees: A headcount counts each person once, whatever their hours; full-time equivalents add up working time, so two half-time employees count as one.
URLOrLinkToThePubliclyAvailableDisclosur: The web address at which the pollution figures are already published, for example a page of a register kept by the environmental authority.
UndertakingAppliesCircularEconomyPrincip: Choose “Yes” if the undertaking deliberately keeps products and materials in use for longer, for example by designing for repair, reusing packaging or recycling its production scrap.
UndertakingHasACodeOfConductOrHumanRight: Choose “Yes” if the undertaking has a written code of conduct or human rights policy that applies to its own employees.
UndertakingHasAComplaintHandlingMechanis: Choose “Yes” if employees have a way to raise complaints or concerns that are then looked into, for example a designated contact person or an anonymous reporting channel.
UndertakingHasConfirmedHumanRightsIncide: Choose “Yes” if a serious breach of the human rights of the undertaking’s own workers was confirmed in the reporting period, for example forced labour or discrimination.
UndertakingHasSetATargetWhichIsRelatedTo: Choose “Yes” if the undertaking has set a measurable target to track the practice, policy or initiative, for example cutting its energy use by a given share by a given year.
UndertakingIsAwareOfAnyConfirmedIncident: Choose “Yes” if the undertaking knows of confirmed serious human rights incidents involving workers at its suppliers or customers, affected communities, consumers or end-users.
UndertakingsAreExcludedFromAnyEuReferenc: Choose “Yes” if the EU rules for climate benchmarks aligned with the Paris Agreement exclude the undertaking, for example because of revenue from fossil fuels, tobacco or controversial weapons.
UndertakingsLegalForm: The legal form under which the undertaking is registered, for example a private limited liability company or a sole proprietorship.
VolumeOfMaterialUsed: How much of this material the undertaking used in the reporting period, by volume — for materials measured by volume rather than weight.
WasteDirectedToDisposalMass: The weight of waste sent for disposal, for example to landfill or incineration, broken down by type of waste.
WasteDirectedToDisposalVolume: The volume of waste sent for disposal, for example to landfill or incineration, broken down by type of waste.
WasteDivertedToRecycleOrReuseMass: The weight of waste sent for recycling or reuse instead of disposal, broken down by type of waste.
WasteDivertedToRecycleOrReuseVolume: The volume of waste sent for recycling or reuse instead of disposal, broken down by type of waste.
WaterDischargeFromUndertakingProductionP: Water released from the undertaking’s production processes back to the sewer or the environment; it is subtracted from the water drawn in to obtain water consumption.
WeightOfMaterialUsed: How much of this material the undertaking used in the reporting period, by weight.
